{"id": 12, "company": "Archer-Daniels-Midland Co.", "risk_score": 50, "knows_later_problems": true, "basis": "Nutrition segment intersegment-transaction issues led to a 2024 SEC/DOJ probe and corrected segment disclosures; consolidated results were largely unaffected."},
{"id": 13, "company": "Bunge Ltd.", "risk_score": 7, "knows_later_problems": false, "basis": "No known accounting problems for FY2022."},
{"id": 14, "company": "Orion Energy Systems, Inc.", "risk_score": 18, "knows_later_problems": false, "basis": "Small-cap with losses; no known restatement."},
{"id": 15, "company": "SAExploration Holdings, Inc.", "risk_score": 92, "knows_later_problems": true, "basis": "SEC charged an accounting fraud over 2015-2019 involving hidden related-party transactions; financials restated and the company went bankrupt."},
{"id": 16, "company": "Baxter International Inc.", "risk_score": 70, "knows_later_problems": true, "basis": "Restated 2014-2019 results for improper intra-company FX transaction gains; SEC settlement in 2022."},
{"id": 17, "company": "Synchronoss Technologies Inc.", "risk_score": 60, "knows_later_problems": true, "basis": "Major restatement of 2015-2016 and SEC fraud charges covering roughly 2013-2017 revenue practices."},
{"id": 18, "company": "Sysco Corp.", "risk_score": 4, "knows_later_problems": false, "basis": "No known accounting problems."},
{"id": 19, "company": "Transatlantic Petroleum Ltd.", "risk_score": 20, "knows_later_problems": false, "basis": "Small E&P with insider control; no known restatement."},
{"id": 20, "company": "AerSale Corp.", "risk_score": 20, "knows_later_problems": false, "basis": "Post-SPAC company with some control weaknesses; no known restatement for FY2021."},
{"id": 21, "company": "Air Products & Chemicals Inc.", "risk_score": 4, "knows_later_problems": false, "basis": "No known accounting problems."},
{"id": 22, "company": "Ammo, Inc.", "risk_score": 75, "knows_later_problems": true, "basis": "Special committee investigation into undisclosed related-party matters and executive conduct, delayed filings, restatements and SEC scrutiny."},
{"id": 23, "company": "Revolution Lighting Technologies, Inc.", "risk_score": 45, "knows_later_problems": true, "basis": "SEC charged revenue fraud (bill-and-hold) mainly for 2016-2018; FY2014 is earlier but shows aggressive acquisition accounting."},
{"id": 24, "company": "Overseas Shipholding Group Inc.", "risk_score": 85, "knows_later_problems": true, "basis": "2012 tax-related restatement withdrew reliance on 2009-2011 financials, followed by Chapter 11 and SEC action."},
{"id": 25, "company": "Ppg Industries Inc.", "risk_score": 65, "knows_later_problems": true, "basis": "2018 restatement over improper accrual reversals affecting 2016-2017; SEC enforcement against the company and its former controller."},
{"id": 26, "company": "theMaven, Inc.", "risk_score": 60, "knows_later_problems": true, "basis": "FY2018 10-K was filed very late with material weaknesses and extensive accounting remediation."},
{"id": 27, "company": "Tidewater Inc.", "risk_score": 15, "knows_later_problems": false, "basis": "FCPA settlement in 2010, but no known financial statement restatement for FY2011."},
{"id": 28, "company": "EPAM Systems, Inc.", "risk_score": 6, "knows_later_problems": false, "basis": "No known accounting problems."}]
